Wednesday NightDiscipleshipWednesday Nights at KLCC are for Discipleship!Looking for Bible-centered classes to help you grow in your faith and apply God's wisdom to everyday life? Our Wednesday night discipleship courses are a place to learn, connect, and grow in your walk with God. Go deeper. Grow stronger. Take your next step.

Fall CoursesSeptember 23 thru December 9Watch the course introductionAlpha 9/23 thru 12/9Alpha is a place to explore life's big questions: What is my purpose? What happens when I die? Why is there suffering? Over 12 weeks, people come together to share thoughts, hear different perspectives, and have honest conversations in a judgment-free environment.Register for AlphaApologetics 9/23-10/28Why believe in God? Can the Bible be trusted? What do we do with questions about suffering? This course explores some of the biggest questions about Christianity and helps you build confidence in what you be

Winter CoursesBible StudyHow to Study the Bible is an 8-week, hands-on course that helps you understand and apply Scripture in daily life. You’ll learn how to observe, interpret, and live out God’s Word through engaging videos, group discussions, and weekly homework. Whether you're just starting or want to grow deeper, this class will build your confidence in studying the Bible.Spring CoursesPrayer CourseExplore the meaning and power of the Lord’s Prayer in this 8-week course. Through engaging discussion and uplifting teaching, you’ll grow closer to God and strengthen your faith. Whether you'r

Other CoursesMarriageThe Marriage Course is a 7-session series designed to help couples strengthen their relationship—whether you've been married for months or decades, and whether things are going well or you're facing challenges. You'll learn practical skills like better communication, resolving conflict, understanding each other’s needs, and building deeper intimacy.On breakRegistration closed
